{{Quote|My peers in the service laughed when I said it was on Hoth, but now--yes, it's the only thing that makes sense.|Lieutenant Talos Drellik expresses his elation to Lord Kallig after confirming the existence of a Sith temple on Hoth|<ref name="Bitter Rivalries" />}}
An [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] '''expedition''' was led by [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talos Drellik]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] on the [[Water/Legends|ice]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in [[3641 BBY]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Drellik led an expedition team to Hoth following up on his theory that a [[Sadow'een Temple|Sith temple]] was was located there. Command of the team was taken over by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] mid-mission to aid the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] in discovering the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of ancient Sith Lord [[Horak-mul]], though both missions were ultimately accomplished.

==The expedition==
===Kallig takes command===
{{Quote|The team's way out in the wastes searching for some mythical Sith Temple, on Hoth of all places.|Imperial Sergeant Loren informs Lord Kallig of a local Reclamation Service team's mission|<ref name="Scouring the Wastes" />}}
[[File:Talos_Drellik_on_Hoth.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Lt. Talos Drellik, team leader.]]
Around [[3641 BBY]]<ref name="3641BBY" />, [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Talos Drellik]] led an [[Archaeology/Legends|archaeological]] team to the [[Water/Legends|snow]]-covered [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] in search of a mythical [[Sadow'een Temple|Sith temple]].<ref name="Scouring the Wastes" />

The [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]] arrived on Hoth pursuing rumors of the presence of a [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] on the planet later that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Kallig had been [[Force walk|binding]] the spirits of long-dead Sith Lords to aid in an ongoing feud with [[Darth Thanaton]], the [[Dark Council]] member overseeing the [[Sphere of Ancient Knowledge]].<ref name="Sith Hierarchy">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|Sith Hierarchy|[[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]}}</ref> The rumors suggested that the previous year, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[Starrunner (light freighter)|Starrunner]]'' was carrying [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] confiscated by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] when strange happenings occurred on the vessel before it finally crashed on Hoth's icy surface. Upon arriving on Hoth, Kallig immediately set out for Drellik's excavation site in [[The Bitter End]] to take command of the Reclamation Service team to aid in the ghost hunt.<ref name="Scouring the Wastes" />

Drellik provided the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] with a [[Shalora]] [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] to locate the ''Starrunner's'' jettisoned [[Distress beacon/Legends|distress beacon]] while his team moved to a new camp to better aid in the search. Upon finding the beacon, Kallig and service [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Qualus Sorrel]] uncovered the final [[Distress signal/Legends|distress call]] from the ''Starrunner's'' captain and discovered unusual days-old tracks in the snow around the beacon. Drellik identified them as [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] tracks and noted they seemed to carry away an object from the crash. Kallig departed for a nearby Ortolan settlement to inquire about their find while Sorrel delivered the beacon to the service team's new base.<ref name="Scouring the Wastes" />

===Missions converge===
{{Quote|Buried deep in the snows of Hoth, you will find the ruins of an ancient Sith temple. The temple was both training ground and burial site for Naga Sadow's personal order of assassins. The assassins who murdered me.|The Force ghost of ancient Sith Lord Horak-Mul, possessing an Ortolan chief, informs Lord Kallig of the presence of an ancient Sith temple on Hoth|<ref name="Bitter Rivalries" />}}
[[File:BattleOfKharDelba4.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Force ghost of Horak-mul revealed the association of Hoth's Sith temple with the personal assassins of Naga Sadow, the Sadow'een.]]
Kallig entered the Ortolan encampment in [[Highmount Ridge]] and slew at least half-a-dozen Ortolans before finally confronting their chief.<ref name="Small but Deadly">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Small but Deadly|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref> During their discussion, the chief became possessed by the Force ghost Kallig sought who identified himself as [[Horak-mul]], former ally of [[Ludo Kressh]] who was murdered by the [[Sadow'een]], [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow's]] assassins, in [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="Bitter Rivalries" />

Horak-mul confirmed he was the cause of the ''Starrunner's'' demise and negotiated with Kallig to offer his strength in return for the desecration of the Sadow'een temple, coincidentally the same temple Drellik's team had come to Hoth to discover. Kallig rendezvoused with Drellik to use his expertise to enter the temple and the two departed for its location in the [[Glacial Fissure]].<ref name="Bitter Rivalries" />

===Discovering the temple===
{{GameDSmechanics|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|The great and secret order of Naga Sadow's assassins, the Sadow'een. This is where they came to die when their bloody work was done.|Lt. Drellik to Lord Kallig as they explore the Sadow'een temple|<ref name="Into the Assassin Temple" />}}
[[File:Sadoween_Temple.png|thumb|right|250px|Lt. Talos Drellik led a Reclamation Service team to Hoth in search of a Sadow'een temple (pictured).]]
Upon arriving at the temple, the pair found they were only able to enter the catacombs section as the rest of the temple seemed to have been destroyed by the planet's harsh weather. Drellik employed his knowledge and skills to gain access to the temple and navigate its traps. Kallig defended Drellik against attacks by Sadow's ancient droids while he worked, defeating over a dozen of them.<ref name="Keepers of the Past">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Keepers of the Past|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>

In accordance with Horak-mul's revengeful desires, Kallig destroyed several relics in the chamber. Satisfied with the destruction, Horak-mul appeared to the two by possessing one of the defeated droids and revealed the location of the ''Starrunner'' in the [[Starship Graveyard (Hoth)|Starship Graveyard]]. Kallig and Drellik proceeded to the Empire's [[Frostwake Outpost]] near the graveyard where Drellik undertook an analysis of the droid possessed by Horak-mul while Kallig proceeded with a follower to the ''[[Star of Coruscant]]'' where the ''Starrunner'' was housed.<ref name="Into the Assassin Temple" />
{{Endgame}}

===Drellik joins Kallig===
{{Quote|My lord! I hoped to catch you before you left! I, um, I have resigned from the service. The military just isn't the best use of my talents. I feel I could serve the Empire better... by, um, by helping you. If you'll let me.|Lt. Drellik offers his services to Kallig|<ref name="The Fallen Dreadnought">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Fallen Dreadnought|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]}}</ref>}}
[[File:Horak-Mul.png|thumb|left|250px|The Force ghost of Horak-mul (pictured) demanded the desecration of the Sadow'een temple in exchange for assisting Kallig.]]
After discovering the ''Starrunner'' and [[Horak-mul's sarcophagus]] in the ''Star of Coruscant'', Kallig successfully confronted and bound the ghost and departed the planet. Drellik intercepted Kallig aboard [[Adamas Space Station]] where he notified the Sith he had resigned from the Reclamation Service and enlisted in Kallig's [[Kallig's powerbase|crew]].<ref name="The Fallen Dreadnought" />

Engineer Sorrel later notified Kallig that the Reclamation Service team had recovered and examined Horak-mul's sarcophagus.<ref name="Horak-Mul">{{TORcite|type=message|Horak-Mul|[[Engineer/Legends|Engineer]] [[Qualus Sorrel|Sorrel]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Please, I know the ghost wants this all destroyed, but let me at least take some holorecordings. To obliterate all this history--why, we'd be orphaning ourselves. A culture needs the hand of the past to guide it.|Lt. Drellik appeals to Lord Kallig for permission to take holorecordings of the temple's relics before destroying them|<ref name="Into the Assassin Temple" />}}
The Reclamation Service Hoth expedition appeared in the Sith Inquisitor class story on Hoth in the [[BioWare]]-[[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[2011]].<ref name="Scouring the Wastes" />

In the Sadow'een temple, the player character may select the light side option of allowing Drellik to take holorecordings of the temple's relics before destroying them.<ref name="Into the Assassin Temple" />
